say:1:1630322101:1.text: We're recruiting brave souls for Woofdale's hero squad!
say:1:1630322101:1.source_cn: 我们在为汪达尔的勇者小队招揽战力！
say:1:1630322101:1.male: We're recruiting brave souls for Woofdale's hero squad!
say:1:1630322101:1.female: We're recruiting brave souls for Woofdale's hero squad!

say:3:1630322103:1.text: There's this cat, Meowris—she's spreading all sorts of anti-human lies. I bet she's up to something sinister!
say:3:1630322103:1.source_cn: 一只叫做喵丽丝的猫在四处宣扬人类不好的言论，她一定有什...
say:3:1630322103:1.male: There's this cat, Meowris—she's spreading all sorts of anti-human lies. I bet she's up to something sinister!
say:3:1630322103:1.female: There's this cat, Meowris—she's spreading all sorts of anti-human lies. I bet she's up to something sinister!

say:6:1630322105:1.source_cn: 因为人类对我们很好！汪！

say:7:1630322106:1.text: They're our best buds. Snacks, games, belly rubs—what's not to love?
say:7:1630322106:1.source_cn: 是的，人类是我们最好的朋友。他们会给我们食物，会陪我们玩耍。
say:7:1630322106:1.male: They're our best buds. Snacks, games, belly rubs—what's not to love?
say:7:1630322106:1.female: They're our best buds. Snacks, games, belly rubs—what's not to love?

say:8:1630322107:1.text: Meowris must've gone through something rough to believe humans are controlling us... poor thing.
say:8:1630322107:1.source_cn: 很难想象喵丽丝是遭遇过什么导致心理扭曲，居然认为人类在...
say:8:1630322107:1.male: Meowris must've gone through something rough to believe humans are controlling us... poor thing.
say:8:1630322107:1.female: Meowris must've gone through something rough to believe humans are controlling us... poor thing.

say:9:1630322108:1.text: Don't worry, we'll stop her! Woof!
say:9:1630322108:1.male: Don't worry, we'll stop her! Woof!
say:9:1630322108:1.female: Don't worry, we'll stop her! Woof!

choice:5:0:1.text: How come you two haven't been brainwashed like the others?
